parts.html: The K-35 kitchen is a modern straight design with a striking combination of light wood texture and dark gray-brown fronts. Its main design feature is the contrast between the central work zone and the surrounding furniture sections: the light woodgrain upper cabinets and backsplash stand out against the dark lower cabinets and tall side units.

This approach creates a cohesive interior composition in which the wood texture brings warmth to the space, while the solid gray-brown surfaces form a calm yet expressive base. The K-35 kitchen is well suited to a modern apartment, condo, or private home, especially where the kitchen is open to the living and dining areas.

The model is 4.6 linear meters long. The straight configuration places the main furniture composition along a single wall. The upper and lower cabinets, tall side sections, work surface, and spaces for built-in appliances form a single functional line.

In the visualization, the central work zone is highlighted with a light woodgrain decor. Above it is a row of woodgrain upper cabinets, and below the countertop are dark gray-brown fronts. The tall side sections are finished in the same dark shade and visually frame the central part of the kitchen.

A built-in oven is provided on the left side of the composition. The sink and cooktop are located in the main work line. When the kitchen is made to order, the position of appliances and plumbing fixtures can be adapted to the room dimensions and the location of utility connections.

Both upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard but differ in their decorative finish. The central upper cabinets have a light woodgrain decor, while the lower cabinets and tall side sections are dark gray-brown. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the countertop is chipboard-based.

The light woodgrain decor on the backsplash echoes the upper cabinets and helps visually unify the central work zone. However, the wood texture does not mean that solid natural wood is used in the standard configuration: the stated front material is laminated chipboard.

Hinged doors are fitted with Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close mechanisms. Pull-out elements run on Muller telescopic slides without soft-close mechanisms. Cabinet handles are included in the standard configuration.
Lift-up mechanisms, a cargo pull-out, and a separate kitchen island are not included in the standard K-35 model.

The K-35 kitchen can be adapted in terms of functionality and materials. At the client’s request, more functional cabinet hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems can be used. Alternative materials are also available, from more budget-friendly to premium options. With a custom order, you can choose the front and countertop materials, the shade of the woodgrain decor, the color of the solid surfaces, and the cabinet interior fittings.

Overall dimensions: 4.6 × 2.3 × 0.6 m
Lift-up mechanism: None
Appliance installation: Built-in
Cargo pull-out: No
Handles: Included
Upper fronts: Laminated chipboard, light woodgrain decor in the central row
Lower fronts: Laminated chipboard, dark gray-brown solid-color decor
Carcass type: 18 mm laminated chipboard
Length: 4.6 linear m
Island: No
Hinges: Muller Profi Line soft-close
Decor: Combination — light wood, dark gray-brown fronts
Drawer slides: Muller telescopic, without soft-close

Additional options: more functional hardware, upgraded mechanisms, additional storage systems, and alternative materials from budget to premium. These solutions are selected separately and are not included in the stated standard configuration.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-35 can be adapted to the dimensions of your specific room, with changes to the length of the furniture composition, the placement of built-in appliances, and the cabinet interior fittings. With a custom order, you can choose a different combination of woodgrain and solid-color decor, front and countertop materials, hardware, and additional storage systems.

We offer furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, we can also select a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
